rationale: Four input contracts in core/view: a disabled view receives no key, text, gesture, hover-enter, press, drag or double-click but still gets the release and exit that finish an interaction; modifier-key changes reach the focused and drag-captured views; focus changes carry a cause and are reported to every ancestor; hover is re-evaluated when content moves under a stationary pointer. The change is pointer and keyboard routing in the view tree plus the script event layer. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, asset or packaging authority moves, and no paint output changes.
tests: pulp build --target pulp-test-group-view-host, then run build/test/pulp-test-group-view-host "[disabled],[modifiers],[focus],[hover]"
